title: Custom Football Player Holding Ball Close Up Comforter with Football Helmet
description:
Transform your space into the ultimate football sanctuary with this custom sports comforter set from Jeminise. Featuring a bold, dark photorealistic illustration of an American football player holding a football close up, this bedding is the perfect gift for football players, fans, and coaches alike. Add a personal touch with customizable name and number options to make your bedroom truly one of a kind.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with your own name (up to 25 characters) and jersey number (up to 5 characters) for a personalized team look.
  • Comfy & Durable Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with soft, lightweight microfiber filling designed to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Vibrant & Fade-Resistant: Advanced printing techniques ensure rich, lasting dye retention with neat, fine stitching along the edges for enhanced durability.
  • Flexible Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover with a hidden zipper closure or a cozy, all-in-one filled comforter.
  • Optional Accessories: Customize your set further by adding matching football-themed pillowcases or an additional flat sheet cover.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry low or air dry for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Microfiber Polyester
Color Dark Football Art
Theme Football / Sports
Style Contemporary
Customization Name and Number inputs
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Care Instructions Machine wash cold, tumble dry low
